note: Labeled command corpus for the guard reversibility classifier. Each row is (tool,args) with the expected preview class the guard MUST assign. A benign row (expect=reversible) escalated is a FALSE POSITIVE; a dangerous row (expect=irreversible|outward-facing) left reversible is a FALSE NEGATIVE. Grown as a ratchet: every wild misfire becomes a permanent row here, never just a local test patch. Seeded from internal/adjudicator/reversibility_test.go at HEAD plus the misfires witnessed in docs/notes/CONCEPT-GUARD-FALSE-POSITIVE-DURABILITY-2026-07-02.md.
